title: Inexact Bregman Sparse Newton Method for Efficient Optimal Transport
summary: Computing exact Optimal Transport (OT) distances for large-scale datasets is computationally prohibitive. While entropy-regularized alternatives offer speed, they sacrifice precision and frequently suffer from numerical instability in high-accuracy regimes. To address these limitations, we propose the Inexact Bregman Sparse Newton (IBSN) method, which efficiently solves the exact OT problems.
